freeTests.title: Airforce Agniveer Vayu Free All-India Mock Test 01
freeTests.instructions: Total 50 Questions: English (20 Qs) + RAGA (30 Qs). Each correct answer awards 1 mark. 0.25 mark will be deducted for every incorrect attempt.

questions.question: Choose the correct synonym of the given word: **CANDID**
questions.explanation: 'Candid' means truthful, frank, and straightforward. Therefore, 'Frank' is the exact synonym.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Neither the teacher nor the students ______ present in the auditorium.
questions.explanation: In 'Neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here 'students' is plural, so 'were' is correct.

questions.question: Identify the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Accommodation' with double 'c' and double 'm'.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of the given word: **OBSOLETE**
questions.explanation: 'Obsolete' means no longer produced or used (outdated). The opposite is 'Modern'.

questions.question: Select the one word substitution: 'A person who loves books'
questions.explanation: A 'Bibliophile' is a person who collects or has a great love of books.

questions.question: If AIRFORCE is coded as 1-9-18-6-15-18-3-5, then what is the code for DEFENCE?
questions.explanation: Each letter is replaced by its alphabetical position number: D=4, E=5, F=6, E=5, N=14, C=3, E=5.

questions.question: Who is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: According to Article 53(2) of the Constitution of India, the Supreme Command of the Defence Forces is vested in the President of India.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the Eastern Air Command located?
questions.explanation: Eastern Air Command of the Indian Air Force is headquartered at Shillong, Meghalaya.

questions.question: If 15 men can complete a project in 20 days, how many days will 25 men take to complete the same project?

ebooks.previewText:
SKC DEFENCE ACADEMY SPECIAL E-BOOK (PREVIEW EXCERPT)

PART 1: THE 50 GOLDEN RULES OF SUBJECT-VERB AGREEMENT

Rule 1: When two subjects are joined by "as well as", "along with", "together with", "with", "in addition to", "accompanied by", "like", "unlike", "rather than", the verb agrees with the FIRST subject.
Example: The Wing Commander along with his squadron (is/are) returning to the airbase. -> Answer: 'is' (Wing Commander is singular).

Rule 2: When two subjects are connected by "either... or", "neither... nor", "not only... but also", the verb agrees with the NEAREST subject.
Example: Neither the pilot nor the navigators (was/were) injured. -> Answer: 'were' (navigators is plural).

Rule 3: Words like 'each', 'every', 'neither', 'either', 'one of the' are always followed by a plural noun but a SINGULAR verb.
Example: One of the Sukhoi-30 fighters (has/have) completed the sortie. -> Answer: 'has'.

gdTopics.title: Agnipath Scheme: Transformation of Indian Armed Forces
gdTopics.introduction: Agnipath is a landmark recruitment reform designed to keep the Indian Armed Forces youthful, tech-savvy, and agile.
pros: Brings average age of troops down from 32 to 26 years
Instills high discipline, fitness, and skill training in Indian youth
Seva Nidhi package of ~11.71 Lakhs enables youth to start businesses or higher studies
Retention of top 25% ensures combat-hardened core cadres
cons: Concerns regarding post-service career opportunities for 75% outgoing troops
Need for continuous transition support and skill recognition certificates
gdTopics.conclusion: With corporate tie-ups and priority quotas in CAPFs and state police, Agnipath strikes a balance between modernisation and youth empowerment.

gdTopics.title: Artificial Intelligence & Unmanned Drones in Modern Combat
gdTopics.introduction: Recent conflicts (Russia-Ukraine, Armenia-Azerbaijan) proved that loitering munitions and AI surveillance are modern war-winners.
pros: Replaces human pilots in high-risk reconnaissance and deep strike missions
Real-time autonomous tracking of enemy radar and artillery positions
Indigenous programs like Tapas-BH, Ghatak UCAV, and Swarm Drones under Make in India
cons: Risk of electronic jamming and cyber countermeasures
gdTopics.conclusion: Integrating AI with human judgment gives Indian Armed Forces a formidable asymmetric edge.

gdTopics.title: Women in Combat Roles in Indian Armed Forces
gdTopics.introduction: From IAF fighter pilots (Avani Chaturvedi, Bhawana Kanth) to permanent commissions in Navy and Army, Indian women are defending the frontlines.
pros: Equality of opportunity based purely on merit and capability
Diverse operational perspectives in intelligence, flying, and naval warfare
Inspires millions of young girls across India to pursue defence careers
cons: Requires tailored field infrastructure and logistical adjustments
gdTopics.conclusion: Merit knows no gender; professional standards and rigorous training produce world-class warriors.

srtScenarios.situation: 1. You are travelling in an express train and suddenly smoke starts filling your coach. The emergency alarm chain is pulled but it does not work. You...
options: Jump out of the moving train to save your life immediately.
Use wet handkerchief on face, locate the coach fire extinguisher to tackle the source, alert the guard/TTE through mobile and passengers calmly.
Start shouting in panic and wait for the train to stop at next station.
Lock yourself inside the train lavatory until help arrives.
srtScenarios.olq: Speed of Decision, Sense of Responsibility, Courage
srtScenarios.explanation: Shows initiative, emotional stability under emergency, active problem solving and concern for co-passengers.

srtScenarios.situation: 2. During your 1.6 km physical fitness run at Airforce Selection Centre, your sports shoe gets badly torn 400 meters before the finish line. You...
options: Stop running, sit down and complain to the ground sergeant.
Remove both shoes quickly or kick off the torn shoe, sprint barefoot with determination, and finish well within the qualifying time.
Slow down to a slow walk to avoid foot injury and accept failure.
Wait for medical team to bring a new shoe.
srtScenarios.explanation: Demonstrates extreme grit and never-give-up warrior spirit to achieve the mission objective.

srtScenarios.situation: 3. You are walking along a riverbank and see a boy drowning. You know only basic swimming. You...
options: Run away from the spot because you are not an expert swimmer.
Shout for nearby locals/fishermen for help, look for a long bamboo pole or throw a rope/inflatable tube to pull the boy safely to the bank.
Jump blindly into deep whirlpool water without any plan.
Record the video on your phone to upload on social media.
srtScenarios.explanation: Uses intelligence and available resources practically without endangering another life unnecessarily.

srtScenarios.situation: 4. Your group is given a problem during Group Planning Exercise (GPE). Two candidates start arguing aggressively with each other, delaying the team. You...
options: Join one candidate and shout down the other.
Stay completely silent and let them fight.
Intervene calmly, synthesize valid points from both candidates, remind them of the common time constraint, and lead the team to a united solution.
Complain to the Group Testing Officer (GTO) about their bad behaviour.
srtScenarios.explanation: Displays conflict resolution, team spirit, and mature leadership under group pressure.

srtScenarios.situation: 5. While returning home late at night, you find an injured motorcyclist bleeding on the roadside with nobody around. You...
options: Ignore him and hurry home because police might question you.
Provide immediate first aid to stop bleeding, call 112/108 ambulance, and transport him to the nearest hospital emergency unit safely.
Take pictures and post on Twitter asking for help.
Inform his relatives from his phone and wait there without doing first aid.
srtScenarios.olq: Sense of Responsibility, Human Values, Decisiveness
srtScenarios.explanation: Takes direct personal responsibility to save a fellow citizen's life.
